title: OASIS 2.0 shared definitions
description: Shared definitions for the OASIS 2.0.0-draft.4 schemas. This file is not a document root. Each entity has one definition here or in its record schema.

spec_version.description: The specification version of this draft.

id.description: An identifier: 1 to 256 code points. The first and last code points are not whitespace, as REC-5 defines it.

reference.description: A string naming the id of a target of a known kind. The rule for each field sets its target and the scope where it resolves (PKG-6).

namespace_token.description: An extension namespace token. The token oasis is reserved and not allowed.

date_time.description: An RFC 3339 date-time with the limits of the contract. Format checking is required.

date.description: A date YYYY-MM-DD with a valid Gregorian date. Format checking is required.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension data. Keys are namespace tokens. Values are objects with open contents.

source.description: Provenance of a record. Never used to resolve references.

record_base.description: Fields shared by every record: id, source, and extensions. Each record schema closes the object.

access.description: Access summary. The whole of access in this draft.

rate.description: A rational frame rate. Lowest terms are checked outside the schema.

time_base.description: A rate and a drop-frame flag. Drop-frame is allowed only at 30000/1001 and 60000/1001.

frame.description: A frame position or duration. An integer, 0 or more.

seconds.description: Elapsed seconds from the start of the timeline. A number, 0 or more.

timecode_label.description: A timecode label HH:MM:SS:FF or HH:MM:SS;FF. Rate specific limits are applied by timeline_rules on each timeline holder.

timecode_label_30_drop.description: Drop-frame label at 30000/1001. Labels 00 and 01 are skipped at the start of each minute except every tenth minute.

timecode_label_60_drop.description: Drop-frame label at 60000/1001. Labels 00 to 03 are skipped at the start of each minute except every tenth minute.

label_rate.description: The rates at which timecode labels are allowed.

timecode_base.description: The timecode rate of a seconds-form source_timecode. Its rate is a label rate.

timing.description: The timeline of an asset or version. Frame form: a time base, an optional duration in frames, and an optional source timecode of frame 0. Seconds form: no time base, a duration in seconds, and an optional source timecode with its timecode base.

checksum.description: A declared digest of a file. Lowercase hexadecimal of the length the algorithm produces.

file.description: One logical file: its content stated once, with the identical stored copies that the source reports. Absent or empty locations: no known copy.

file_location.description: One stored copy of a file.

image_sequence.description: A compact image sequence: one numbered name pattern. Frame numbers name images, not timeline positions.

sequence_image.description: The size or checksum of one image of a compact sequence.

member.description: One track of a file group: a file, and the stream inside it when known.

segment_index.description: Order of this file within one recording that is split across several files. Numbering belongs to the original recording and starts at 0. Order only; a part start gives placement.

ratio.description: A ratio of two positive integers, such as 16 to 9.

track_language.description: A BCP 47 tag of a track. The tag und, in any letter case, is not allowed: absence states an unknown language.

file_group.description: An explicit set of files that belong together for one purpose.

version.description: One version of an asset and the information that belongs to it.

timeline_rules.description: Timeline rules that need the timing of an asset or version: frame fields need a time base, labels need a source timecode at a label rate, and label syntax follows the rate and drop-frame flag of the time base, or of the timecode base in the seconds form.

unassigned.description: Information of an asset with versions whose version the source does not state. It has no timeline.

without_position.description: An annotation with no position field.

without_part_starts.description: A file group whose members carry no part start.

not_subclip.description: A relationship whose type is not subclip_of.

time_range.description: A range on the target timeline, in frames, seconds, or both. Inclusive start, exclusive end.

relationship.description: A typed link from this asset to a target asset. A subclip requires a range.

media_type.description: Media type syntax: type and subtype of registry name characters (RFC 6838 section 4.2). Syntax only; registration is not checked.

language_tag.description: Language tag well-formedness per RFC 5646 section 2.1: language, optional script, region, variants, extensions, private use, and the grandfathered forms, all case insensitive. Syntax only; subtag registry membership is not checked.

scalar_value.description: One metadata value of any type: a JSON string, integer, number, or boolean. Objects and null are never values.

metadata_value.description: A definition reference and a value. The value is a scalar or an array of scalars; its shape against the definition's value_type and cardinality is checked outside the schema. Null is not a value.

metadata.description: Metadata values on an asset, a version, an unassigned area, a collection, or an annotation.

option.description: One allowed value of an enum definition.

constraints.description: Informative data about a source field. Never executed over values.

collection_storage.description: The storage location and path a storage collection mirrors.

membership.description: One membership of this record in a collection.

member_of.description: The collections this record belongs to. Membership is recorded on the member only.

annotation_fields.description: Fields of an annotation. Not closed on its own.

embedded_annotation.description: An annotation inside an asset, a version, or an unassigned area. It has no asset, type, or spec_version field. It may carry source provenance.

record_list_counts.description: Declared record count per package array.

namespace_declaration.description: Declaration of one extension namespace token in a package manifest.

manifest.description: Who produced the package, when, declared counts, the extension namespaces used, and, in a multi-file package, the member files.

members.description: The member files of a multi-file package. Present only in the manifest file of a multi-file package. The order has no meaning.

member_entry.description: One member file of a multi-file package: its path under the package folder, the record type it holds, its record count, and its size and SHA-256 digest as stored.

path.description: Path of the member file, relative to the package folder, with / as the separator. It starts with a record folder name and ends in .jsonl or .jsonl.gz.

record_type.description: The record list that the file feeds. It names the first segment of the path.

count.description: Number of records in the file.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file as stored, so the compressed size for a .jsonl.gz file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the file as stored: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
